stage_timing_limit: Backend process timings and RPC tool durations are measured; a process/tool can span multiple stages. Identical timing files are grouped, not asserted to be distinct invocations. No complete independent per-stage wall-clock instrumentation.
resource_coverage_limit: Controller samples the observed Logos descendant process tree. Detached/reparented Fluent/MPI processes can escape that tree; GNU-time around a Python launcher need not cover native solver descendants. RSS sums can double-count shared pages. These values are partial sampled measurements, not complete solver resource accounting.
